run_testspeed_benchmark: run the mjx testspeed benchmark on a mujoco model with configurable batch size and solver
test_mjx_benchmark: test the mjx.benchmark function with a given model, step count, and batch size
run_testspeed_tsv_output: run testspeed with tsv output format for machine-readable benchmark results
run_testspeed_custom_solver: run testspeed benchmark with newton solver and custom iteration counts
run_testspeed_parallel_rollouts: run testspeed with multiple parallel rollouts to measure jit and simulation throughput
